TermsPage.heading: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.legalReviewNotice: Draft terms — pending review by a legal professional before go-live.
TermsPage.orderingCopy: By placing an order with Zain's Treat n More, you confirm that the details you provide are accurate and that you are authorized to place the order.
TermsPage.paymentCopy: Payment terms and accepted payment methods will be confirmed at the time of order or booking.
TermsPage.cancellationCopy: Cancellation requests should be made as early as possible. Cancellation terms may vary depending on the order type and how close it is to the delivery or event date.
TermsPage.refundsCopy: Refund eligibility depends on the circumstances of the order and will be assessed on a case-by-case basis.
TermsPage.deliveryCopy: Delivery and pickup options, timing, and any associated fees will be confirmed when an order is placed.
TermsPage.cateringCopy: Catering orders may require advance notice, a minimum order size, and a deposit depending on the scale of the event.
TermsPage.eventBookingsCopy: Event rental bookings are subject to availability and should be confirmed in advance of the event date.
TermsPage.customerResponsibilitiesCopy: Customers are responsible for providing accurate order, delivery, and contact information, including any allergy or dietary requirements.
TermsPage.websiteUsageCopy: This website should be used only for lawful purposes related to browsing, ordering, and enquiring about our food and services.
TermsPage.changesCopy: Zain's Treat n More may update menu items, services, and prices at any time without prior notice.

FoodRegulationsPage.heading: Food Regulations
FoodRegulationsPage.halalCopy: Our meals are prepared in line with halal requirements as part of our commitment to serving the community we belong to.
FoodRegulationsPage.hygieneCopy: Food is hygienically prepared and handled in accordance with good food-safety practice.
FoodRegulationsPage.ingredientsCopy: We use fresh, carefully selected ingredients, sourced and prepared with care.
FoodRegulationsPage.allergensIntro: Please inform us about any allergies or dietary requirements before placing your order.
